name: update_node_pool
description: Updates a specific node pool within a GKE cluster.

parameters.description: MCPUpdateNodePoolRequest updates a node pool for a cluster.

name.description: Required. The name (project, location, cluster, node pool) of the node pool to update. Specified in the format 'projects/*/locations/*/clusters/*/nodePools/*'.

update.description: Required. A [node pool update request](https://cloud.google.com/container-engine/reference/rest/v1/projects.locations.clusters.nodePools/update) represented as a string using JSON format.
